meta.name: Clip Out: Backrooms
meta.short_description: Play solo or in 2-player online co-op in this PSX style extraction roguelite based on the Backrooms. Explore procedural levels, scavenge for loot, and extract alive to upgrade your gear.

meta.name: Cubetoria Pentomino Challenge
meta.short_description: Twelve pieces. One perfect fit. Build all twelve pentominoes from real 3D cubes and fill the build plate, matching every lettered anchor. 220 computer-checked challenges on five plates, a Daily Challenge, Free Build and the Cubetoria crew to cheer you on.

meta.name: Limited-time Game Bundle Challenge
meta.short_description: A bunch of Normal Retro Classic games, but what if, you need to change to another game when the Count Down ends. How many Score can you get?

meta.name: Strato Alto
meta.short_description: Strato Alto - high flying arcade rogue-lite with classic round survival and permadeath campaign modes. Take off with a variety of aircraft, weaponry, special abilities, to zap, blast and smash your way to victory! Upgrade, repair, and outfit your aircraft to master the stratosphere in Strato Alto!

4959350.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me

meta.name: Take This Thing Out Of Me
meta.short_description: It's a short game. But it can be a long one. It all depends on whether you were born under a lucky star... or whether you have the skill in your hands. Just... take the thing out!

meta.name: Runecast
meta.short_description: A pixel-art autobattler: cast runes, set your company across three lanes and watch your strategy decide the fight. Merge heroes, pick promotions, gear up your troop and march through four acts, from the Palisade to the Basalt Hall, against bosses that demand preparation.

meta.name: Shelfish
meta.short_description: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with Shelly the hermit crab, plus a fresh drawer every day.

meta.name: The Sixth Sin
meta.short_description: The Sixth Sin is a horror game set in a suspense-filled atmosphere where you battle demons, supernatural beings, and puzzles, surviving through your own ingenuity. The voice guiding you is one of them. Manage your inventory, complete rituals, and never let go of the light or your magical items.

meta.name: Spirestorm
meta.short_description: Dive into enemies and rebound skyward in this arcade action roguelite. Climb a 25,400-metre tower, forge upgrades, and decide when to bank your haul.

5521470.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators

meta.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
meta.short_description: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack for the one original. An incremental hidden object parody.

meta.name: Beryl
meta.short_description: Team up with up to three friends in a free-to-play action RPG. Build your hero from 720 skills, find rare gear, socket gems into your gear, and fight through 840 kinds of monsters and 14 colossal bosses on ever-harder world difficulties.

meta.name: Pocket Dynasty
meta.short_description: Coach an American football team in modern-retro pixel art. Call every play, hand the headset to your coordinators, or take the snap yourself. Draft rookies, bring legends back as coaches, chase a title, and challenge a friend on one PC or online.

meta.name: Coins in Place
meta.short_description: A short incremental game about picking up every last coin. Miss even one before the day ends, and you're stuck working another week! Buy upgrades, recruit cats to help, and find your own way to a perfect week. Every coin in place.

meta.name: Dopamine rogue
meta.short_description: Manage your dopamine, earn money, build decks, and navigate life's challenges in this psychological life-simulation roguelike. Every choice shapes your story as you struggle to survive your own mind. A solo-developed project crafted over two years.

meta.name: Before it Falls
meta.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

meta.name: Monsters Can Cook
meta.short_description: You were a bad person in your past life, and now you'll have to work as a junior chef even after death. Buy questionable ingredients, cook for guests, and improve your skills until your restaurant gets five stars.

meta.name: Valliberum Memory Challenges
meta.short_description: Three tabletop memory games on one virtual table. Remember species and colour, plan a nature expedition, or match pairs across a mischievous 8x8 map. Play solo for a high score, locally against a friend, or against the CPU.

5136620.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit

meta.name: SOS :Should I Stay or Should I Hit
meta.short_description: S.O.S is a roguelike deck-building game built on blackjack. Collect cards, build your deck, and turn the odds of blackjack in your favor.

meta.name: FRAGILE!
meta.short_description: Online co-op moving company for 1–4 players. Carry sofas, pianos and chandeliers with both hands through 10 places and 40 contracts... and break nothing. A new Daily Contract every day, Steam leaderboards and Twitch chat chaos votes.

meta.name: VICIOUS CIRCLE
meta.short_description: Spiral into madness.

5319410.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon

meta.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
meta.short_description: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

meta.name: BroCode
meta.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

meta.name: Clocks Sleep at Zero
meta.short_description: A puzzle game where every clock must count down to zero together!

meta.name: MYTHHUNT
meta.short_description: Hunt cryptids in a hostile open forest, alone or with up to four players in co-op. Scavenge supplies, hunt wildlife, craft gear and customize firearms. Survive each encounter, reach extraction and bring your hard-earned loot back to the lodge.

meta.name: Prism Factory
meta.short_description: Wire rainbows in a factory of light. A prism splits white light into red, green and blue. Bend the beams, mix them, and deliver the colour each order asks for: red and green make yellow. Orders keep coming, until your single white beam becomes rainbow wiring across the whole board.

meta.name: Zombie Apocalypse Together
meta.short_description: Fight zombies, scavenge cities, explore the wild, hunt, craft and build a base in a world that is new every game. Start with nothing and survive with up to 3 friends. Every seventh night, the Blood Moon brings the horde to your walls.

meta.name: 装甲奇兵
meta.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. Start with Eileen / Ghost, unlock two more crews, fight nine stages, and push each battlefield from Easy to Nightmare.

meta.name: Azure Ruins
meta.short_description: Azure Ruins is a hex-board merge roguelike where shape, count, and rank drive your strategy. Pair Trait Runestones, Relic rules, and special mechanics to stack chains and multipliers. Spend limited Stamina to crack an island city's mechanisms, storm the Royal Vault, and climb global leaderboards.

meta.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
meta.short_description: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

meta.name: Zombie Outbreak - Co-Op Edition
meta.short_description: Survive with your allies with up to 4-Player Online Co-Op survival and try to resist death in classic round-based zombies. Can you survive the zombie outbreak?

meta.name: Put It Away Please
meta.short_description: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

meta.name: Oh Baby Blocks
meta.short_description: A cozy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

meta.name: Mischka Cars
meta.short_description: Top-down combat racing with rockets, mines and oil, a career across five leagues, rollercoaster stunts on stilted tracks and car football with ramps and bumpers. Tune your car in the garage, build your own tracks and earn 75 achievements.

meta.name: The Great Himalayan Noodle Descent
meta.short_description: Build a slide from the summit of Everest, all 29,031 feet of it, and send a pile of flailing noodles hurtling to the bottom. Bend, loop, and launch your way past cliffs and crevasses using real physics. How many noodles will survive the trip?

meta.name: Coding War
meta.short_description: Program a combat robot and send it to battle against other robots.

meta.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!
meta.short_description: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

meta.name: Chronocracy
meta.short_description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

meta.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow
meta.short_description: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

meta.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
meta.short_description: Steal valuable goods by night and sell them in your own shop by day. Turn stolen loot into profit, upgrade your store, and grow your criminal business. Take on bigger, riskier heists to keep your shelves stocked and your profits rising - but watch out, the police are closing in.

meta.name: Astral Forge: Desktop Alchemist
meta.short_description: A desktop alchemy game. Type and move your mouse to gather resources; control the heat, forge items, find rare affixes and fill your collection. Exchange supplies with other players. Eligible items can enter Steam Inventory and the Community Market. Internet required.

meta.name: Depthline
meta.short_description: Go 18 floors down a quarantined building. Pick the room, watch your survivor gun down the zombies and grab the gear they drop. Merge twins into rarer items, stack class bonuses and build a loadout that can reach Patient Zero. An inventory-management roguelite where the build wins the fight.

meta.name: Appulse
meta.short_description: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!

meta.name: Pet Pet Pet: Tidy Up!
meta.short_description: 3,000 sleepy pets have taken over your shop. Scoop up kittens and puppies from 150+ adorable breeds, tuck each one into its matching bed, and watch total chaos turn into a perfectly organized pet paradise. No timers. No pressure. Just pets.

meta.name: Fool's Trigger
meta.short_description: Welcome to the table where life is the stake. Fool’s Trigger is a tense mix of Russian roulette and a card game for 6. Load your revolver, manipulate the cards, put lives on the line, and dare to find out who will be the unluckiest today.

meta.name: Stompworks
meta.short_description: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to take it all back. One mech. One run. No continues.

meta.name: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
meta.short_description: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

meta.name: Attack of the Astrals
meta.short_description: Heroes and villains fight the cosmos in this tactical roguelike! Every move unleashes an attack in quick battles that reward creative strategies. Combine necromancy, explosives, mimicry and more to thwart the evolving Astral threat!

meta.name: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: Grand Spectacle: Tidy Up Together is a cozy first-person sorting game. Put 2,304 costumes, hats and props back in their wardrobes. Play alone or with up to three friends, learn useful abilities, assemble paintings and bring the theatre back to life.

meta.name: Unknown Depths
meta.short_description: Climb down a deep, dark shaft with up to three friends. A blind worm grows out of the rock and hunts you by scent: move fast and it follows your trail. Light holds it back, but not for long. Hook, swing and rappel deeper, while your friends' voices echo down the shaft.

meta.name: Midnight Yakiniku | 深夜焼肉
meta.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a yakiniku restaurant in Japan. As the owner, you open the restaurant and welcome customers as usual. But that night, orders begin arriving from Table 7—a table that shouldn't exist...

meta.name: Shark Mart
meta.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

meta.name: Night Concierge
meta.short_description: November 2003. Night shift at the front desk of a post-Soviet apartment block. Something is wearing your neighbors' faces. Check the resident log, question visitors over the intercom and call their apartment: if they answer from home, who's at the door? PS1-style first-person horror.

meta.name: Voidrush
meta.short_description: Pilot your rocket through an endless 3D tunnel, from the planet's surface into space. Dodge rotating obstacles, risk a boost for extra points and beat your personal best. Play solo or challenge up to three computer opponents. German-language interface.

meta.name: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
meta.short_description: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

meta.name: Idle Demon Slayer
meta.short_description: Build a party of up to five heroes in this single-player Chinese fantasy idle RPG. Auto-battle for gear with random affixes and collect offline rewards. Combine formations, combat styles, and cultivation manuals to take on secret-realm bosses and climb the Endless Tower.

4776590.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price

meta.name: Iron Ledger: Deterrence Has A Price
meta.short_description: A high-pressure management sim where you build a defense contractor from nothing, secure contracts, expand production, manage staff and supply chains, and fight to stay ahead of cash flow, compliance, and collapse.

meta.name: TrapRush
meta.short_description: TrapRush is an online party platformer for 2 to 12 players. Each round, everyone places one item on the same course: a bridge, a spring, or a saw hidden under it. Then you all race to the flag at once. Make it while your friends don't, and you score.

meta.name: Planet Chess
meta.short_description: Six boards. Two players. One ultimate showdown. Planet Chess transforms classic chess into an intense multiplayer battle where you fight across six independent boards at once. Outsmart your opponent, master every move, and claim victory!

meta.name: Gravity Switch
meta.short_description: Slide, dodge, and survive! A retro-inspired arcade puzzle game where every move propels you until you literally hit a wall. Collect every dot across 50 hand-crafted stages, dodge deadly hazards, and unlock the warp crystal to escape. Features a dozen unique chiptune tracks!

meta.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
meta.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

meta.name: Reshine
meta.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

meta.name: Eyelord Returns
meta.short_description: Eyelord is an intense, fast-paced, heavy metal match-3 pop 'em up. It is a relentless massacre of innocent rolling eyeballs, using a mouse, touchscreen, or game controller. Get into the flow alone, or bring a friend to the slaughter!

meta.name: The Pogo Witch
meta.short_description: A challenging hand-drawn 2D platform game. Master the pogo technique and climb to the top of the tower, where its creator awaits.

meta.name: Shiver Slopes
meta.short_description: A fast-paced action game where you ski through dangerous slopes, dodge obstacles, and shoot enemies (in bullet time) while navigating procedurally generated mountains. Race for high scores or beat your best times.

meta.name: Watch My Step!
meta.short_description: Invisible traps, different perspectives, and only one way out! In this 2–4 player online co-op platformer, every player sees different traps. Warn each other, overcome the course together, and climb to the top of the leaderboards with your best time!

meta.name: 4th Supplementary
meta.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, haunted school loop. Evade the lingering spirit, seal the anomalies, and find a way out before it's too late.

meta.name: Put Out The Sun
meta.short_description: Put Out The Sun is a co-op incremental game about one ridiculous job: extinguishing a star. Land on the Sun as a crew of four-armed aliens, spit and spray it dark, mine ice, build conveyor lines and turrets, and automate everything until the last flicker. For 1-6 players.

meta.name: TOP STEED
meta.short_description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

meta.name: No Mercy
meta.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

meta.name: TaskBound Saga
meta.short_description: An idle JRPG that sits above your taskbar. Four heroes fight through 12 realms on their own while you use your computer. Open the chests they earn, equip the gear and upgrade your party.

meta.name: QuizForge
meta.short_description: Create quizzes with images, audio and videos. Play solo, together on one PC or online via Steam. Connect smartphones over your local network, and discover or share quiz packs on Steam Workshop.

meta.name: Galactic Arms
meta.short_description: Command a mighty fleet of battleships. Upgrade and customise your ships with powerful modules, and traverse the cosmos to outmanoeuvre and defeat your opponents in this strategic single-player card game.

meta.name: Slop Squad
meta.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Vacuum up valuable scrap from procedurally generated maps and get it back to the scrap crusher before the things lurking inside get you.

meta.name: Shole Soccer
meta.short_description: Shole Soccer is a chaotic online soccer game where ball obeys physics - and your friends don't obey rules. Kick, stun or tackle your way to victory over your friends.

meta.name: Near The Sun
meta.short_description: Near The Sun is a 2D action-adventure game where you slice through enemy lines with sharp dashes and race across a collapsing underworld. Experience a story that changes depending on the order you explore, and discover a way to save a girl from a long-lost "previous world."

meta.name: SwitcHead
meta.short_description: SwitcHead is a chaotic online co-op game for 2 where you control your friend's head... and they control yours. Shout directions, search the factory, crack the safes and build each brick toy before the conveyor belt carries it away!

meta.name: No Man's Sky
meta.short_description: No Man's Sky is a game about exploration and survival in an infinite procedurally generated universe.

meta.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
meta.short_description: Escape the ordinary with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! meta.name: No More Room in Hell 2
meta.short_description: No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense 8 player zombie shooter. Overcome the endless undead. Avoid infection. Survive hell together.

meta.name: Tape to Tape

Choose your path, hire unique players, discover synergies between them, pick unique abilities, bribe the referees or visit the Blademaster on your way to restore hockey's former glory.

meta.name: Teardown
meta.short_description: Prepare the perfect heist in a fully destructible, simulated voxel world. Tear down walls with vehicles or use explosives to create your own shortcuts. Shape the environment to your advantage in the most creative ways you can imagine. Play solo or with up to 12 players in multiplayer.

meta.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
meta.short_description: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of movie and video game rentals!

meta.name: Monster Train 2
meta.short_description: Monster Train returns with all new clans, new enemy factions, new challenges, new modes and more! Defend your Pyre in the classic three-tiered, vertical gameplay that made the original roguelike deckbuilder a hit.

meta.name: What the Buck?!
meta.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

meta.name: Potion Craft: Alchemist Simulator
meta.short_description: Potion Craft is an alchemist simulator where you physically interact with your tools and ingredients to brew potions. You're in full control of the whole shop: invent new recipes, attract customers and experiment to your heart's content. Just remember: the whole town is counting on you.

meta.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
meta.short_description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

meta.name: Oboro no Ichi
meta.short_description: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

meta.name: DAWN AEROWAR
meta.short_description: A two-hour animated film. Follow Zodiac 1, an ace pilot out for revenge against the Empire, across 12 episodes of 3D dogfights and hand-drawn 2D animation, with a full voice cast and an original orchestral score. Nearly five years of work by a handful of independent artists.

meta.name: Hozy
meta.short_description: Restore a forgotten neighbourhood through your favourite hobby, one cozy room at a time. In Hozy, clean, paint, and decorate abandoned homes with satisfying mechanics and intuitive controls. Enjoy the little details as you interact with tools, items and furniture to bring each space back to life.

meta.name: Safari-TV
meta.short_description: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

meta.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
meta.short_description: Work your way to a service empire. Get your hands dirty in a highly realistic simulation game that pays major attention to details. Pay a visit to a new Auction house and buy cars in various conditions. Expand your range of services by investing in a new work space and equipment.

meta.name: Brick Buddies
meta.short_description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

4096830.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready

meta.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
meta.short_description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

meta.name: Escape Simulator
meta.short_description: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

meta.name: Absolum
meta.short_description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

meta.name: The Witness
meta.short_description: You wake up, alone, on a strange island full of puzzles that will challenge and surprise you.

meta.name: County of Fortune
meta.short_description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

meta.name: Well Dweller
meta.short_description: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

meta.name: Plague Inc: Evolved
meta.short_description: Plague Inc: Evolved is a unique mix of high strategy and terrifyingly realistic simulation. meta.name: Message From Aliens
meta.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

meta.name: Graveyard Keeper
meta.short_description: Build and manage a medieval graveyard while facing ethical dilemmas and making questionable decisions. Welcome to Graveyard Keeper, the most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim of the year.

meta.name: Hull Rupture
meta.short_description: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

meta.name: Plan B: Terraform
meta.short_description: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water, and forests.

1369630.name: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights

meta.name: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights
meta.short_description: ENDER LILIES is a dark fantasy 2D action RPG about unraveling the mysteries of a destroyed kingdom. On this sorrowful journey, encounter horrific enemies against whom a moment of inattention could be fatal. Overcome these hardships and seek the truth with the help of fallen knights.

meta.name: Nocturnal 2
meta.short_description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

meta.name: Legend of Defenders
meta.short_description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

meta.name: Transport Fever 2
meta.short_description: The classic transport simulation genre has a new gold standard with Transport Fever 2. Discover a whole new world by navigating transport routes through land, water and air. May progress and prosperity find their way!

5051080.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game

meta.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
meta.short_description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

2725260.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist

meta.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
meta.short_description: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

meta.name: This War of Mine
meta.short_description: In This War Of Mine you do not play as an elite soldier, rather a group of civilians trying to survive in a besieged city; struggling with lack of food, medicine and constant danger from snipers and hostile scavengers. The game provides an experience of war seen from an entirely new angle.

meta.name: For The King
meta.short_description: For The King is a strategic RPG that blends tabletop and roguelike elements in a challenging adventure that spans the realms. Set off on a single player experience or play cooperatively both online and locally.

meta.name: Wizardry: The Five Ordeals

meta.name: Xiuxian Purge

meta.name: Ueru

meta.name: GNOMINAL

meta.name: Frame343

meta.name: Neon Run

meta.name: A Drop of Magenta
meta.short_description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

meta.name: Örnöga: Idle & Loot

meta.name: Huex

meta.name: HachaMeccha Reversi
meta.short_description: No turns, no waiting! Up to 4 players fire discs at once in real-time Reversi matches lasting about 2 minutes. Clash midair, use special discs, and flip even corner discs with charge shots! Play online, team up in 2v2, or go solo in Survival and Score Attack.

meta.name: Street Value
meta.short_description: You owe the Shark, and you have thirty days. Deal across seven gritty New York neighborhoods with one deck: Hustle cards bend the market; Street cards shake the cops. Take turf from rival crews, survive Collection Day, then risk it all for one more week!

meta.name: BORE
meta.short_description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

meta.name: Last State
meta.short_description: Every decision has a cost. Scavenge, hunt, craft, and build a life in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic wilderness. Last State is a hardcore survival simulation where hunger, cold, injuries and one bad decision can end your story for good.

meta.name: Moon Base: Tidy Up Together
meta.short_description: Thousands of things are dumped in one giant pile at a Moon base. Climb it, bound across the cargo yard in low gravity and put every last item back where it belongs, on your own or with up to three friends, in this cosy co-op tidy-up game.

meta.name: Bush League Baseball
meta.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, nine ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, race go-karts between innings and play for the World Series. One or two players.

meta.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive
meta.short_description: Hijack enemy processes. Steal their kits. A tactical roguelike on a 7×7 grid where every enemy is carrying something you can take lifesteal, defense, entire ability kits. Build from 200+ programs. The system adapts to hunt you. Permadeath. No negotiations.

meta.name: Overcooked! All You Can Eat
meta.short_description: Experience all the Onion Kingdom has to offer, Overcooked! 1 & 2 infused with 4k goodness running at a smooth 60 FPS. Fully remastered and cooked up from scratch. Enjoy 200+ levels (22 new) and 80+ chefs (3 new), this is the ultimate Overcooked! experience.

meta.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
meta.short_description: A boy with a flashlight. A house that will not let him go. Explore, solve hands-on puzzles, and survive supernatural encounters in a side-scrolling horror adventure that reaches far beyond its walls with strange worlds, sudden chases, and terrifying enemies to confront.

meta.name: I'd Choose the Bear
meta.short_description: Thirty days to save your late Nana's cottage in Honeywood, a lakeside town where bears and people live side by side. Date six very different bears (one of them is technically a human), outwit a resort developer, and decide who you'd really rather meet in the woods.

meta.name: Hellwake
meta.short_description: Your heroes fight on their own. You build the killing machine. A dark fantasy auto-battler RPG with deep classic loot: seven classes, uniques, sets and runewords, a town to raise, and runs you burn for permanent power as you descend through seven acts of Hell.

meta.name: Gotta Catch Bugs!
meta.short_description: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

meta.name: Bone Bazaar
meta.short_description: This is a Sword And Sandals inspired Turn-based arena RPG. Play a skeleton gladiator in the Greek underworld: pick one action per round, shatter enemy armor, forge and enchant weapons, cheer up a crowd of ghosts. Beat 4 arenas and 4 bosses to face Hades, who swore the winner goes free.

meta.name: Trash Inc.
meta.short_description: Turn a bankrupt recycling yard into a smooth-running operation in this relaxing incremental management game. Open bags and sort waste by hand, hire a crew, install processing machines, and automate the journey from truck delivery to valuable recycled goods.

meta.name: Kabakura
meta.short_description: Kyabakura Wars is a kyabakura management sim with a visual novel inside. Take a club drowning in debt, turn it into the best venue in town, and defeat the four rival bosses standing between you and fame.

meta.name: Wreck the Deck
meta.short_description: Take control of a powerful pirate cannon and turn everything on deck into flying debris! Shoot cannonballs, destroy objects, trigger devastating shockwaves, and collect cash to unlock powerful upgrades. The more you wreck, the stronger your cannon becomes.

meta.name: Dead Last
meta.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

meta.name: BitLoaf
meta.short_description: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

meta.name: Rec Room: A New Semester
meta.short_description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

meta.name: Lavender's The One Stop Potion Shop
meta.short_description: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

meta.name: Crônicas Improváveis
meta.short_description: Experience tabletop RPG without gathering a group. Create your hero, speak and act in your own words as an AI Game Master narrates, portrays characters, and guides an epic campaign written by authors. Begin your journey in Act I of The Throne of Beasts.

meta.name: The drawing of the Exodus
meta.short_description: This is a summary of the Book of Exodus from the Bible, told using images generated by artificial intelligence and accompanied by brief captions.

meta.name: Starwinder
meta.short_description: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

meta.name: Hypothesis Sudoku
meta.short_description: A classic 9×9 Sudoku game built around logical deduction and branching hypotheses. Mark assumptions separately from deductions, manage candidates, backtrack through multiple branches, and progress through ten chapters containing 100,000 puzzles.

meta.name: Chess Lords
meta.short_description: A cinematic medieval chess saga! Take on 12 rivals in the Campaign, play Free Battle, solve 24 checkmate puzzles and watch every capture become a brutal, piece-specific execution.

meta.name: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
meta.short_description: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

meta.name: Swift Cultivation
meta.short_description: Swift Cultivation is a text-based idle cultivation game. Set your action queue and let time do the rest: breakthroughs happen on their own, food gets eaten for you, and every death makes you stronger. Fight, craft — and ascend.

meta.name: CHASA : Twilight Reaper
meta.short_description: Become a Grim Reaper in this isometric horde-survival action game. Choose your weapon, combine and ascend your skills, and challenge powerful Guardians. Shape your build with gear and the Spirit Vein passive skill tree.

meta.name: Chalk Thrower Simulator
meta.short_description: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

meta.name: Echoes of the Flame
meta.short_description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

meta.name: Why Not Fly That?
meta.short_description: Strap thrusters to shopping carts, fridges, and everyday objects in this single-player physics sandbox. Build your own flying machine, assign its controls, and fly, tumble, and tackle obstacles. Experiment with each design and see how far it goes.

meta.name: Slimy Dude
meta.short_description: Slimy Dude is a semi-linear 3D gravity-puzzle platformer. Master running your way through gravity-bending puzzles, explore vibrant planetary zones, hunt for Neutronium Emeralds to unlock new galaxies and track down a missing person to fulfil your promise!
